description: Phase 5 test event for ApprovalFunction — API Gateway REST (v1) proxy format for GET /approval. Test with: sam local invoke ApprovalFunction --event events/test-approval.json. The token must equal HMAC-SHA256(secret, incident_id) hex-encoded, where secret is the plaintext of the SSM parameter /llm-incident-response/approval-token-secret. Compute it with: echo -n '<incident_id>' | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac '<secret>'
